# How to Collect Reviews with Yezza Review


This article is only applicable if you have **completed all review settings** .


Collecting reviews is a powerful way to build trust with your patients and improve your clinic’s online presence. Yezza Review offers multiple ways to encourage patients to leave feedback.


---


## 1. Print Yezza Review QR


Display your Yezza Review QR code at your front desk so patients can easily scan and leave a review.


**Steps:**


1.


Go to **Clinic Management > Review > Settings > Sharing**


2.


Click **Download as PNG**


💡 **Tips:**


-


Make your QR more attractive by designing it in **Canva** or other editing tools before printing.


-


Place it in visible spots like the reception counter or waiting area.


---


## 2. Automate Review Collection


Let Yezza automatically send review invitations to patients after their visit. No manual effort needed.


**Steps:**


1.


Go to **Clinic Management > Review > Settings > Automation**


2.


Turn on **Automation**


3.


Choose **Email** as the sending method.


---


## 3. Use WhatsApp to Ask for Reviews


Boost engagement by sending review invitations directly via WhatsApp.


**Steps:**


1.


Go to **Review > Invitation tab**


2.


Click the **WhatsApp icon** to send the invitation


---


## 4. Be Proactive in Asking for Reviews


Encourage your staff to personally request reviews from patients. Direct interaction often works best!


💡 **Tips & Methods:**


-


Set a **daily target** (e.g., 3 reviews/day = 90 reviews/month).


-


Offer **small incentives** (discounts, free gifts) for reviews — best used when your Google Profile is new or rating is low.


-


Reward staff who successfully collect reviews from patients.


---


## 5. Add Customers Manually in Yezza


If you are not using **Yezza CMS** or **Yezza Appointment** , you can still collect reviews by adding customers manually.


**Steps:**


1.


Go to **Review tab > Get More Review**


2.


Enter the **customer’s name & phone number**


3.


Click **Save**


4.


The customer will now appear in your **Invitations tab**


---


✅ With these methods combined, your clinic can build a steady flow of genuine reviews that strengthen trust and attract more patients.
